publicApiEvidence: No XHR/fetch data endpoint was observed on any captured page. The portal renders server-side and posts back through full page requests.
integrationRestrictions: No public, self-service API is published for this portal.
Public forms are CAPTCHA-protected; automated submission is not available.
Authenticated functionality sits behind a server-side session and is out of scope.
safetyPolicy: Endpoints here were observed passively while loading public pages. No endpoint was enumerated, fuzzed or probed. No credential, session token, cookie or authorization header was recorded: those header names are stripped before anything is written to disk. No request body was captured.
